proposedModel.question: Do you foresee any issue related to the blood sampling requirements listed below?
proposedModel.rows: Study template can define the default row list (ADA, HbA1c, …), but every SAVED response freezes a snapshot of the rows + answers used that day

retention.rule: Never lose prior answers when the study template row list changes
how: Each survey response stores rowsUsed[] + answers{} as an immutable snapshot
Editing the study's default sampling list only affects NEW sends — old responses keep their original rows/answers
Row catalog (ADA, HbA1c, etc.) lives in a reusable library of sampling items so identity is stable across studies
If a later study adds/removes a row, historical feasibility still shows what that site answered then

designProposals.why: One question. Rows are unique reusable items. Study can choose which rows to ask, but saved responses retain the full snapshot forever.

designProposals.canonical: Mandatory equipment / facilities access for this study
coversFromSettleList: Access to Local Lab to complete ESR

twoLayers.description: Site owns/has a catalog of equipment & facilities (generator, slit lamp, OCT, local lab access, etc.). Maintainable over time. Not study-specific.
Study picks required items from the equipment catalog. Site answers Yes / No / No but can procure (+ optional note).
twoLayers.prefill: If site inventory already has the item, default Yes and show confirm

retention.rule: Editing the study required-equipment list must NOT rewrite prior responses
how: Saved response freezes itemsAsked[] + answers{} snapshot
Site inventory updates over time; historical feasibility still shows the answers from that send
Equipment items (generator, ESR lab, ophthalmoscope) are stable catalog IDs reused across studies

itemsAsked: Back-up generator in the event of a power outage
Access to Local Lab to complete ESR
Indirect ophthalmoscope for dilated fundus examination

designProposals.why: Yes/No per item, reusable catalog + site inventory, per-study checklist — with immutable response snapshots so history is never edited away.

splitKeepSeparate.modelHint: Use repeatable profile arrays (investigators[0], investigators[1]) or device inventory rows — not alias merges.
